title: Debiasing Text-to-Image Evaluation via Implicit Cultural Alignment Reward Modeling

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image generation models using pairwise ranking on the CulturalFrames benchmark to assess alignment with implicit cultural expectations, norms, and visual cues across diverse geographic regions and five sociocultural domains (Family, Greetings, Etiquette, Religion, Dates of Significance).
